functions.name: GetConstraintIndex
functions.docs: Get the index of the constraint in the physics asset

functions.name: IsConstraintOnParentBody
functions.docs: since constraint are showing on both parent and child, gets  if this tree item is the one on the parent body

functions.name: IsCrossConstraint
functions.docs: True if the bones affected by this constraint are not adjacent (parent/child) in the owning skeleton. Constraints between non-adjacent bones are referred to as 'cross-constraints' and have different icons in the editor.
